mara_sales: Quick POC ask from Ellen: SD-WAN -> TGW (active/active). Want PrivateLink into us-east with automatic fallback to an egress proxy in us-west. Must preserve client source IP for logs. Need minimal firewall ports and a 1TB/month cost delta vs Hosted.

toni_se: Short: doable. Use regional interface endpoint in each region fronted by TCP NLBs (preserves src IP). Failover via BGP local-pref or a small TGW route automation. PrivateLink is regional, so one endpoint per region.

sam_netops: Firewall checklist (minimal):
- Spoke/TGW -> endpoint ENIs: TCP 443
- NLB health checks -> connector health port: TCP 8080
- Proxy (secondary) -> primary NLB probes: TCP 443
Note: avoid NAT gateways in path to keep source IP.

mara_sales: Cost note: PrivateLink + NLB = hourly ENI + hourly LB + per-GB processing + cross-region egress. Hosted: no infra but higher variable per-token cost. Dedicated lowers per-token if traffic steady but has fixed commit. We'll provide numbers in ticket.

ellEN_customer: Can you include MTU guidance? We've seen fragmentation with SD-WAN overlays.

sam_netops: MTU note: enable MSS clamping on edge. Example: iptables -t mangle -A FORWARD -p tcp --tcp-flags SYN,RST SYN -j TCPMSS --clamp-mss-to-pmtu. Also test session failover expected on region flip.

ticket-bot: Created POC-90234 : "privatelink-tgw-failover-poc" assigned to sam_netops,toni_se - https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/POC-90234

mara_sales: Action: sam drop runbook + cost sketch in ticket by EOD tomorrow.

ellEN_customer: Thanks, will await the runbook."
